ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP, OFAC, UN, and domestic sanctions screening for all UBOs, directors, and shareholders; full compliance with Spanish AML/CFT standards

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Strict adherence to Spanish language and Latin script; names must follow Spanish grammatical rules and cannot contain prohibited or reserved terms
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Protected terms including 'Banco', 'Caja', 'Estado', 'Reino', 'Rey', 'Reina', 'Presidente', 'Gobierno', 'Ministerio', 'Congreso', 'Senado'; names infringing intellectual property rights or similar to public institutions
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Administrative appeal to the Commercial Registry within the statutory period upon rejection; escalation to contentious-administrative proceedings before the appropriate court if necessary

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010 of 2 July approving the consolidated text of the Capital Companies Act (Ley de Sociedades de Capital, 'LSC') — Arts. 4 (minimum capital), 20-34 (incorporation formalities), 124-133 (registered office), 153-175 (limited liability company rules), 209-213 (administrators); Royal Decree 1784/1996 of 30 July (Mercantile Registry Regulations); Law 14/2013 of 27 September (Support for Entrepreneurs and their Internationalisation) permitting accelerated electronic incorporation through the CIRCE system.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Commercial Registry for name reservation) and Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province of the registered office; the incorporation deed is executed before a Spanish Notary and coordinated electronically through the CIRCE platform (Centro de Información y Red de Creación de Empresas).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura de constitución (public deed of incorporation) granted before a Notary, followed by mandatory inscription in the Registro Mercantil Provincial; ancillary filings include Modelo 036 for the provisional and definitive tax identification number (NIF/CIF).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum paid-up capital of EUR 3,000 required by Art. 4 LSC; capital must be fully subscribed and paid at incorporation. Cash contributions must be deposited in escrow in a Spanish credit institution or with the Caja General de Depósitos, and the corresponding depositary certificate must be attached to the notarial deed. Non-cash contributions require expert valuation under Art. 67 LSC.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporation of the company as a Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada under the laws of Spain is hereby approved; that the share capital of EUR 3,000 is fully subscribed and paid in accordance with the public deed; that the registered office is fixed at [address], Madrid, Spain; that the administration is entrusted to two joint administrators designated in the deed; that the administrators are hereby appointed with all powers conferred by Article 209 of the Capital Companies Act; that the first fiscal year closes on 31 December; and that the founders are authorized to execute, notarize, and file the necessary instruments before the Notary and the Mercantile Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve the Corporate Name and Obtain the Negative Name Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central — CIRCE electronic portal (Centro de Información y Red de Creación de Empresas)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit through the CIRCE online platform, or directly at the Registro Mercantil Central, a request for certificación negativa de denominación social providing up to three corporate names ranked in order of preference. The Registry searches its database for identical or misleadingly similar names and, if none is found, issues a negative name certificate that reserves the company name exclusively for a non-extendable period of six months. The certificate must be presented to the Notary and the Provincial Mercantile Registry at later stages.
required_dossiers: Solicitud de certificación negativa de denominación social (official application form)
Identity documents (passport or Spanish NIE) of each founding partner
Proposed corporate names listed in descending order of preference
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is denied because of coincidence or similarity with an existing registered entity, promptly file a new application with revised name alternatives; the Registry typically resolves the renewed request within three working days. A company cannot proceed to notarization without a valid negative name certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open a Provisional Bank Account and Deposit the Minimum Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution of the founders' choice (regulated and supervised by Banco de España)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional account in the name of the future company expressed as 'Sociedad [name] en constitución'. Deposit the full subscribed capital of at least EUR 3,000. Obtain the bank's official depositary certificate (certificado de depósito bancario) stating the future company name, the deposited amount, and the account number. The certificate must be dated within the two months prior to the execution of the deed and remains blocked until the company is inscribed in the Mercantile Registry.
required_dossiers: Negative name certificate from the Registro Mercantil Central
Copies of founding partners' identity documents (passport or NIE)
Completed account-opening and KYC/AML forms of the financial institution
Draft statutes or a brief corporate purpose statement for bank due diligence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the application for incomplete KYC information, supply the additional documentation or select an alternative credit institution. The certificate must be issued strictly in the name of the future company; a misdirected certificate will be rejected by the Notary and must be reissued before the deed is signed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute the Public Deed of Incorporation Before a Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría (Notary Public) chosen by the founders — any notarial district within Spain
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: All founding partners must appear personally before the Notary, or be represented under a sufficient public power, bringing the reserved name certificate, the bank depositary certificate, the draft bylaws (estatutos sociales), and the appointment of administrators. The Notary verifies the legal capacity of the parties, reviews the legality of the bylaws against the LSC, reads the deed aloud, and receives the signatures. The Notary also applies telematically for the provisional NIF with the AEAT immediately after execution.
required_dossiers: Certificación negativa de denominación social
Certificado de depósito bancario evidencing payment of at least EUR 3,000
Draft statutory bylaws (Estatutos Sociales)
Original passports or NIE documents of all founding partners
Written acceptance of office by each appointed administrator
Completed ultimate beneficial owner declaration and AML form for the notarial protocol
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary identifies statutory clauses contrary to the LSC or requests amended AML declarations, revise the bylaws and resubmit the corrected draft for same-day execution. If the deposit certificate has aged beyond two months, obtain a fresh bank certificate before execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the Provisional Tax Identification Number from the Tax Agency
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) — provincial or local tax office of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Notary submits the provisional NIF application electronically through Modelo 036 together with the execution of the deed. Alternatively, the legal representative may appear in person at the corresponding AEAT office within the statutory timeline. The provisional CIF allows the company to issue invoices and register for VAT and corporate income tax before final registration in the Mercantile Registry; the definitive NIF is granted following registry inscription.
required_dossiers: Modelo 036 (Censo de Obligados Tributarios) signed by the legal representative
First copy or authorized excerpt of the public deed of incorporation
Identity documents of the legal representative
Proof of registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEAT rejects the filing for missing data or inconsistent CIF application, correct the Modelo 036 and resubmit; the AEAT must resolve provisional NIF requests within ten working days and will issue the certificate retroactively to the date of the deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscribe the Company in the Provincial Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province where the registered office is located (e.g., Registro Mercantil de Madrid)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month of the deed date, deposit the first copy (primera copia) or a digital certified copy of the escritura de constitución at the Provincial Mercantile Registry. The Registrar examines the legality of the deed and the bylaws, verifies the prior negative name certificate and the bank deposit requirement, and upon approval issues the inscription certificate. Registration confers full legal personality on the company. Registry tariffs are governed by the Arancel del Registro Mercantil and are payable before inscription.
required_dossiers: Primera copia of the notarial deed of incorporation
Provisional NIF certificate issued by the AEAT
Payment receipt of the applicable registry fee
Negative name certificate for verification by the Registrar
Completed Modelo 036 tax census registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a defect note (nota de calificación) or a refusal to inscribe, remedy the listed defects within the appeal period and resubmit the deed; an appeal (recurso gubernativo) may be lodged with the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública or the competent civil court against erroneous registration refusals.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete Employer Registration, Obtain the Definitive NIF, and Open Operational Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS), Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), and the competent local ayuntamiento
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Mercantile Registry inscription, register the company as an employer with the TGSS using Modelo TA.7 and affiliate the administrators/employees within the statutory deadlines. Apply for the definitive NIF at the AEAT using Modelo 036 together with the registry inscription certificate; complete VAT and corporate income tax census entry, and declare the commencement of activity to the local ayuntamiento through a mere declaración responsable/comunicación previa when physical office premises are opened. For a digital design subscription service, no sectoral state or autonomous-community license is required; nevertheless, ensure compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (RGPD) for client and user data processing.
required_dossiers: Modelo TA.7 employer registration application with the TGSS
Modelo 036 for the definitive NIF and census update
Inscription certificate issued by the Provincial Mercantile Registry
Municipal declaración responsable or comunicación previa de actividad for office premises (if applicable)
RGPD records of processing activities and data protection policies
IAE (Economy Activities Tax) declaration applicable to the activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the TGSS or AEAT queries the filings, provide the missing certificates and updated models within the granted term; late registrations can be regularized upon payment of the corresponding surcharge, but no penalty arises where the request is lawfully completed within the statutory grace period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: None for this digital service sector — no industrial establishment is created. In the event of occupying physical office premises, the competent authority is the municipal licensing department (Ayuntamiento/Concejalía de Urbanismo) of the registered office city; any industrial land-use approval would fall under the Dirección General de Industria, Energía y Minas of the respective Comunidad Autónoma.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sectoral operating, industrial, or manufacturing license is statutorily required for product interface design and digital design subscription services (ISIC 7410 / NAICS 541430). A municipal 'declaración responsable' or 'comunicación previa de actividad' for office use may be required when the company occupies physical premises.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITECO) and the corresponding environmental council of the autonomous community (e.g., Consejería de Medio Ambiente in the Community of Madrid).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the activity is not listed under Annex I or Annex II of Law 21/2013 of 9 December on environmental assessment; no full EIA, simplified environmental assessment, or integrated environmental permit is required for a non-industrial design studio. Only municipal environmental ordinances on noise, urban waste, and similar matters may apply to the office premises.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No statutory industrial wastewater, VOC, or dust emission thresholds apply. The company must nevertheless comply with Royal Decree 105/2008 (production and management of waste) and Royal Decree 110/2015 (waste electrical and electronic equipment) for decommissioned IT equipment and packaging; municipal waste collection and noise ordinances apply to the physical office; greenhouse gas reporting obligations may apply should the company exceed the applicable thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety compliance with Section SI of the Technical Building Code (Código Técnico de la Edificación) for office occupancy, typically evidenced through the building's official occupancy certificate; occupational risk prevention under Law 31/1995 and Royal Decree 39/1997 requiring a signed risk assessment, appointment of an external prevention service, staff safety training, and first-aid equipment; structural load suitability confirmed by the cédula de habitabilidad or municipal occupancy clearance for office use. No major-accident (Seveso) or explosion license applies.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: For low-risk office leaseholds, the building's certificate of occupancy for tertiary/office use suffices; the company must file the pre-emptive notification of activity, obtain a fire safety attestation where the local ordinance requires it, and maintain an occupational safety dossier comprising the workplace risk assessment, emergency plan, employee training record, and first-aid supplies as mandated by Law 31/1995.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), including the Sede Electrónica de la Agencia Tributaria at sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es. The AEAT administers Spanish tax identification, corporate income tax, value added tax, customs and related tax filings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada obtains its provisional and final Número de Identificación Fiscal (NIF) through the AEAT. The incorporation package normally includes the notarised deed, certification of name reservation, articles of association, registered office details, identification of directors and shareholders, and evidence of registration or pending registration with the Commercial Registry. The provisional NIF is generally requested using Modelo 036 after execution of the incorporation deed; the final NIF is obtained after Commercial Registry registration and submission of the registered deed and updated corporate information. A foreign company or non-resident entity requiring a Spanish tax identifier applies for an NIF through the AEAT using Modelo 036 and submits constitutional documents, proof of existence, registered address, tax-residence information, and identification of its legal representative. Foreign documents may require apostille or legalisation and certified Spanish translation. The Spanish NIF is also used as the VAT identification number, normally with the prefix ES for intra-Community transactions. A separate VIES registration is required for intra-Community VAT transactions and is requested through the relevant Modelo 036 registration or modification.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A Spanish SL is ordinarily subject to Spanish Corporate Income Tax as a separate taxable entity and has no general United States-style check-the-box election. Available elective regimes may include Spanish tax consolidation for qualifying groups, the special regime for entities holding foreign securities (ETVE) where statutory conditions are met, the REDEME monthly VAT refund regime, and other sector-specific or group regimes. Certain entities without a commercial purpose may fall under income-attribution rules rather than ordinary entity-level taxation. Spanish anti-hybrid mismatch rules can deny deductions or impose inclusion where an arrangement produces a deduction/non-inclusion or duplicate deduction outcome. Any regime election must satisfy statutory eligibility, notification and timing requirements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Spanish Value Added Tax (Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido, IVA), harmonised with the EU VAT Directive. Mainland Spain and the Balearic Islands apply Spanish IVA; the Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla are outside the territorial scope of Spanish IVA and have separate indirect tax systems.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 0; Spain has no general domestic turnover threshold below which a business is automatically exempt from VAT registration. A person carrying out or intending to carry out VAT-taxable economic activities must generally register before commencing the activity. Special rules apply to exempt activities, intra-Community transactions, distance sales, and non-established businesses.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Spain does not currently operate a universal real-time invoice-clearance system for all businesses. Businesses subject to the Immediate Supply of Information regime (Suministro Inmediato de Información, SII), including generally taxpayers exceeding EUR 6 million of annual turnover, VAT groups and taxpayers registered in the monthly refund register, must transmit specified VAT ledger data electronically to the AEAT, generally within four calendar days, subject to statutory exceptions. The invoicing software integrity and traceability requirements under Royal Decree 1007/2023 and its implementing framework require compliant billing systems, including secure records, traceability, anti-alteration controls and, where applicable, VERI*FACTU functionality; applicable implementation dates depend on the final regulatory timetable and taxpayer category. The Law on the Creation and Growth of Companies provides for phased B2B electronic invoicing obligations, subject to implementing regulations and effective dates. Invoices must contain mandatory Spanish and EU VAT particulars, and electronic invoices must preserve authenticity, integrity, legibility and accessibility.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods from mainland Spain or the Balearic Islands to destinations outside the EU VAT territory are generally exempt with the right to deduct input VAT, economically equivalent to zero-rating, where the goods leave the EU customs territory and the supplier retains reliable proof of export. Intra-Community supplies of goods to a VAT-identified customer in another EU Member State may qualify for exemption with the right to deduct, provided the customer has a valid EU VAT number, the goods are dispatched to another Member State, transport is evidenced, and applicable recapitulative statement and reporting requirements are satisfied. B2B supplies of ordinary design, UX and digital services are generally located where the business customer is established under the reverse-charge place-of-supply rule; a supply to a business customer established outside Spain may therefore be outside the scope of Spanish VAT, subject to customer-status, establishment and anti-abuse evidence. B2C digital services, electronically supplied services and services involving special place-of-supply rules require separate analysis and may trigger Spanish, EU or non-EU VAT obligations. Export treatment must be stated correctly on the invoice and supported by contemporaneous commercial and transport evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: For goods: electronic export customs declaration submitted through the Spanish customs system, including the Movement Reference Number or equivalent customs reference and the electronic exit confirmation.
Commercial invoice identifying the supplier, customer, goods, value, delivery terms and destination.
Transport evidence, such as bill of lading, air waybill, carrier confirmation, CMR, courier proof of delivery or equivalent evidence demonstrating exit from the EU customs territory.
Sales contract, purchase order and shipping or logistics records linking the goods to the export transaction.
For intra-Community supplies: customer VAT identification number, transport evidence to another EU Member State, and required recapitulative statement or equivalent VAT reporting evidence.

For offshore B2B services: customer legal name, business address, foreign tax or business registration evidence where available, contract, service description, invoice, payment records and evidence supporting the customer's business status and place of establishment.

An inward remittance certificate is not generally a Spanish VAT export condition. Bank payment evidence may be retained as corroborating commercial evidence, but Spain does not generally impose a universal foreign-exchange repatriation certificate requirement for VAT zero-rating or export exemption.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The AEAT may deny the export exemption or intra-Community exemption where exit, transport, customer VAT status, invoicing or reporting evidence is incomplete or contradictory. Denial can result in assessment of Spanish VAT, statutory late-payment interest and repayment of refunds or input VAT credits obtained on the basis of the claim. Incorrect tax treatment may attract administrative penalties under the General Tax Law, commonly calculated by reference to the unpaid or improperly refunded tax and potentially ranging from 50% to 150% depending on the classification, concealment, fraudulent conduct and aggravating circumstances. Customs infringements may generate separate customs debt, penalties and seizure or forfeiture consequences under EU customs law and Spanish implementing rules. Deliberate tax fraud may constitute a criminal offence where the statutory tax-loss thresholds and other criminal-law requirements are met. Records supporting export treatment should generally be retained for the applicable Spanish tax limitation period, ordinarily four years, subject to extensions, interruption, longer accounting obligations or pending litigation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of Annual Accounts (Cuentas Anuales) — balance sheet, profit and loss account, statement of changes in equity, notes and, when applicable, management report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil) where the SL's registered office is located
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval by shareholders; approval must occur within six months after fiscal year-end. For a 31 December year-end: approval by 30 June and deposit by 31 July. Off-cycle fiscal years: anniversary-based rule.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: ICAC penalties of EUR 1,200 to EUR 60,000 for non-deposit, late or inconsistent accounts; one year after the missed statutory deadline the Mercantile Registry closes the company's file (cierre registral), blocking unrelated corporate filings until accounts are deposited; continued non-compliance exposes the SL to forced dissolution/liquidation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporation Tax Return (Impuesto sobre Sociedades, Modelo 200)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Tax Administration Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria, AEAT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 25 days after the six-month period following the tax year-end. For a 31 December tax year: filed and paid by 25 July of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 5% to 20% plus late-payment interest; penalties from 15% to 35% on amounts wrongly declared; estimated assessment by AEAT and potential attachment and embargo if the return is not filed after formal notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Update / Confirmation (Titularidad Real)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil), coordinated with the Ministry of Justice central UBO register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted together with the annual accounts deposit; for a 31 December year-end by 31 July. Changes in beneficial ownership occurring during the year must be communicated promptly and notarized share transfers entered in the Register of Members before the annual confirmation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: AML/CTF infraction regime: warnings and fines up to EUR 60,000 for non-updated UBO information; prevention of corporate office filings in the Mercantile Registry until the UBO declaration is regularized.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory external audit if, for two consecutive years, the SL exceeds at least two of: total assets over EUR 4.0 million; net turnover over EUR 8.0 million; average workforce over 50 employees. Exemptions cease if the SL is part of a consolidated group or subject to special regulation.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP under the Plan General de Contabilidad (PGC), Royal Decree 1514/2007 and subsequent amendments; listed groups and consolidated financial statements may apply IFRS as adopted by the EU.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SL confirms UBO details in the annual Titularidad Real declaration when depositing annual accounts. Any share transfer must be formalized by notarized public deed and recorded in the Libro Registro de Socios before or simultaneously with the annual UBO reconfirmation. The statement also reports any changes during the year; a failure to update exposes the SL to AML sanctions.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors (appointment and removal resolutions inscribed in the Mercantile Registry and minuted in the board minute book)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 600-1,800 for a compliant registered office and registered-agent package in Madrid/Barcelona or as-a-service jurisdictions
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 3,000-9,000 for a small or mid-size SL mandated audit; exempt small SLs may rely on a voluntary review at 1,200-2,500

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 25% headline rate with R&D tax credits (up to 42% of eligible expenses for SMEs), accelerated depreciation, and other preferential deductions

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 100 - Annual Corporate Income Tax Return, submitted electronically through the AEAT e-portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 25 days following the end of the fourth month after the tax period end (e.g. 25 May for calendar year fiscal year-end)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net profit after adjustments for tax purposes including depreciation, provisions, and income inclusions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A for Spanish resident SL entities

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: 60% of the tax due plus 0.4% per day of delay, capped at 600% of the tax due; criminal liability for fraudulent filings

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 19% on dividends distributed to non-resident shareholders
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Obtain and submit Treaty Relief Certificate (TRC) to the Spanish tax authorities or withholding agent; requires proof of tax residence and beneficial ownership
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties at 19% statutory rate, reduced under DTAs to 0-10%; Interest at 19% statutory, reduced to 0% under most DTAs if conditions satisfied

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: 250,000 EUR for local file requirements on related-party transactions
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic substance requirements apply to certain Spanish tax regimes and holding structures; non-compliance may lead to recharacterization of transactions

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate under-declaration of taxable income or overstatement of deductible expenses
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines equivalent to 100% of the undeclared amount plus imprisonment from 2 to 6 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability; possible disqualification from management positions and restitution orders

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining Spanish SL without sufficient business operations or employees in Spain
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterization of income as non-deductible; fines up to 1 million EUR and potential dissolution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil and criminal sanctions including fines and possible jail time for fraudulent incorporation

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare or file local file documentation for transactions exceeding 250,000 EUR
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines of 10,000 to 100,000 EUR per infractions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Joint and several liability for tax deficiencies and possible administrative sanctions

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to report suspicious cross-border fund transfers or maintain beneficial ownership registers
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to 300,000 EUR and potential criminal prosecution under AML law
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines and imprisonment for willful non-compliance
